title: Abbas-e-Ammu Jaanam
body:
Abbas-e-Ammu Jaanam
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas..
Jane wafa-e-alam..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Darya par tum jaao, paani lekar aao
Pyaase hai hum sab, pyaasa hai asghar
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo darya behta hai, sab ka gala sukha hai
Tum bhi to pyase ho, baba bhi pyasa hai
Bhari ho lakho par..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Lo ye alam mashkiza, mere pyare chacha
Tumko mili sakkai, qurbaa tumpe sakina
Ae saniy-e-haider..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sukhe hai sab kooze, samjhe bache kaise
Sahil par pehra hai, badal bhi na barse
Kab jaenge hum ghar..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya fauje adaa hai, kya iska pehra hai
Tum ho saniy-e-haider, pyase ho to kya hai
Kya rokega lashkar..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jane lage jab ghazi, goonji aaho zaari
Lab pe dua-e-lekar, peeche chali shehzadi
Ehle haram nauhagar..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ammu laut ke aana, humko na rulwana
Rakhe khuda hum sab ke , sar pe alam ka saaya
Ae munis-o-yawar..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Bole ye rokar ghazi, wada karo ye bibi
Jab ye alam chup jae, aae alam jab khali
Na rona ye kehkar..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas-e-ammu janam..(4)
